name: America class
note: US Navy America-class landing helicopter assault (LHA) ship. Its striking power is the embarked air group (F-35B / AV-8B jets, MV-22 Osprey, and attack/transport helicopters), not ship-launched missiles; the only armament is self-defence (RAM, ESSM, Phalanx CIWS), which is not modelled as offensive weapons. Crew/speed below are estimates.

name: Mistral class

Capability is the embarked helicopter group and landing force; armament is self-defence only (Simbad RAM launchers, small guns), not modelled as offensive weapons. All platform figures below are commonly-cited estimates (specifications table not captured on fetch).
